name: Osage-Orange
desc: Osage-Orange (Maclura pomifera): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Maclura pomifera, commonly known as the Osage orange ( OH-sayj), is a small deciduous tree or large shrub, native to the south-central United States. It is a member of the mulberry family, Moraceae.
